articles.summary: The model selector is now available in the editor on web and iOS.
articles.title: You Can Now Choose Your Model in Bloom

articles.summary: Every time the agent makes a change to your app, that state is saved as a version. Open version history to browse through the timeline of your app and revert to any point with one tap.
articles.title: Version History is Now Available in Bloom

articles.summary: You can now upload media directly into Bloom and use it in your app.
articles.title: Upload Images and Assets Into Your App

articles.summary: You can now attach files directly in the chat when building your app.
articles.title: Attach Files to Your Prompts

articles.summary: We've added a new step to how Bloom handles prompts. When you describe something and the agent needs more context to get it right, it now asks you a short set of clarifying questions before building.
articles.title: The Agent Now Asks Before It Builds

articles.summary: Code streaming is now live in Bloom.
articles.title: Watch the Agent Write Code in Real Time
